Aspen Acres, Custer County. Transfer of command from CIMT (NR Team 6) to CIMT (RM Team 3) will occur 
today. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with creeping, flanking and 
backing. Numerous residences threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 1). Two miles north 
of Ouray, CO. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with backing, creeping and smoldering. 
Numerous structures and critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (NW Team 8). Seven miles northwest of 
Lake City, CO. Timber, heavy slash and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping, smoldering and single tree 
torching. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior with smoldering, creeping and isolated torching. Residences and communication 
infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area 
yesterday. 
 
Ferris, San Juan NF, USFS. Seven miles east of Cahone, CO. Timber and brush. Minimal fire behavior with 
smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Keystone, White River Field Office, BLM. Forty-five miles northwest of Meeker, CO. Brush, timber and 
dormant brush. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Residences threatened. 
 
* SR Buffalo, Sheridan County. Thirty-two miles east of Sheridan, WY. Grass and brush. Active fire behavior 
with running and spotting. 
 
Fishhook, Medicine Bow-Routt NF, USFS. Eight miles southeast of Steamboat Springs, CO. Grass, brush and 
timber. No new information. 
 
Fuhr Gulch, Moffat County. Three miles southwest of Craig, CO. Brush and grass. No new information.
